text: きじも　なかずば　うたれまいに　って　ことか

structure.en: even the pheasant, if it didn't cry
so that's what this is, huh

patterns.name: 〜ということだ
patterns.explanation: って is the casual form of という, and ということ wraps up what came before as 'that's what it means'. って　ことか = 'so it's a case of that, huh'.

patterns.name: 〜なければ
patterns.explanation: ずば is an old-fashioned way to say 'if not', used here because this is an old proverb. なかずば = 'if it didn't cry'.

patterns.name: 〜まい
patterns.explanation: まい is an old way to say 'probably won't', here on うたれる 'to get shot'; に adds a regretful 'and yet'. うたれまいに = 'it wouldn't get shot, alas'.
